steps.name: 443 users table

steps.name: 455 memberships
steps.sql: SELECT g.guid, CAST(m.user_id AS TEXT) AS user_id FROM user_group_members m INNER JOIN user_groups g ON g.id = m.user_group_id ORDER BY g.guid, m.user_id

steps.name: 456 device group access
steps.sql: SELECT d.guid, u.username FROM device_group_user_access a INNER JOIN device_groups d ON d.id = a.device_group_id INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id ORDER BY d.guid, u.username

steps.name: 457 device group group access
steps.sql: SELECT d.guid, g.guid AS user_group FROM device_group_user_group_access a INNER JOIN device_groups d ON d.id = a.device_group_id INNER JOIN user_groups g ON g.id = a.user_group_id ORDER BY d.guid, g.guid

steps.name: 458 device groups
steps.sql: SELECT guid, name, note, source_type, tag_filter FROM device_groups WHERE name <> 'Default' ORDER BY guid

steps.name: 459 peer grants
steps.sql: SELECT CAST(user_id AS TEXT) AS user_id, peer_id FROM user_peer_grants ORDER BY user_id, peer_id

steps.name: 460 strategy assignments
steps.sql: SELECT u.username, a.strategy_guid FROM strategy_assignments a INNER JOIN users u ON u.guid = a.target_key WHERE a.target_type = 'user' ORDER BY u.username

steps.name: 461 panel access policies
steps.sql: SELECT subject_type, subject_id, resource_key, access_level FROM panel_access_policies ORDER BY subject_type, subject_id, resource_key

steps.name: 462 client feature policies
steps.sql: SELECT subject_type, subject_id, feature_key FROM client_feature_policies ORDER BY subject_type, subject_id, feature_key

steps.name: 463 pictures
steps.sql: SELECT CAST(user_id AS TEXT) AS user_id, version FROM user_avatars ORDER BY user_id
